basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and League of Legends enthusiast, I recently started my journey on Reddit to connect with fellow players and improve my gameplay. Located in Washington, I work as a junior IT technician, and I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after a long day at work. I'm in a committed relationship and spend my weekends exploring outdoor activities or catching up on the latest gaming trends. I'm still getting accustomed to Reddit's diverse community and its vast range of discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Reddit and its communities, primarily gained through trial and error over the past few months. My knowledge about League of Legends is intermediate, mostly from playing the game and watching streams. I am still unfamiliar with advanced strategies and technical jargon. My educational background includes a degree in Information Technology, which helps me navigate tech-related subreddits.
